proposals.old_text: Classify the input into exactly one of: urgent, billing, technical, feature, security, other.
proposals.new_text: Classify the input into exactly one of: urgent, billing, technical, feature, security, other. If the input relates to a billing issue, classify it as billing.
proposals.hypothesis: By explicitly stating that billing issues should be classified as billing, the agent may better recognize and categorize billing-related inputs.
proposals.expected_improvement: This change should reduce misclassifications related to billing.
